query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, x."口径", x."收益率（%）" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('隐含收益率', round((v.implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('现金支持口径', round((v.cash_implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('要求收益率', round((v.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2))) x("口径", "收益率（%）") ORDER BY v.sort, 2

SELECT x.price AS "买入价", '隐含收益率' AS "系列", round((vi_irr(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.price) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "收益率" FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(greatest(1, floor(cc.latest_price * 0.5))::int, ceil(cc.latest_price * 1.6)::int) x(price) UNION ALL SELECT x.price, '要求收益率', round((f.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(greatest(1, floor(cc.latest_price * 0.5))::int, ceil(cc.latest_price * 1.6)::int) x(price) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT round((x.r * 100)::numeric, 1)::text || '%' AS "要求收益率", s.name AS "情景", round(vi_pv(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.r)::numeric, 2) AS "最高买入价", x.r, s.sort FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(40, 100, 5) / 1000.0 AS r) x UNION ALL SELECT round((x.r * 100)::numeric, 1)::text || '%', '市场价', round(cc.latest_price::numeric, 2), x.r, 99 FROM vi_model_base m JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(40, 100, 5) / 1000.0 AS r) x ORDER BY 4, 5

SELECT p.year, x.item, round(x.amount::numeric, 1) AS amount FROM vi_projection p JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = p.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', p.np_parent), ('计划股息', p.dividend), ('FCFE', p.fcfe)) x(item, amount) WHERE p.is_base ORDER BY p.year, x.item

SELECT h.year::text AS year, '历史' AS kind, round(h.interest_debt::numeric, 0) AS debt FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE h.interest_debt IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.year::text, '预测', round(fc.debt_close::numeric, 0) FROM vi_forecast_base f JOIN vi_forecast_calc fc USING (id) JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY year

SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', h.np_parent), ('分红总额', h.dividend_total)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('经营现金流', h.cfo), ('资本开支', h.capex)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

SELECT h.year, x.item, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS pct FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', h.gross_margin), ('ROE', h.roe)) x(item, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

SELECT h.year, round(h.volume::numeric, CASE WHEN h.volume < 100 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) AS "业务量" FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE h.volume IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year
SELECT f.dimension AS "维度", f.score AS "评分" FROM vi_fit_score_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' ORDER BY f.sort, f.id

SELECT m.code AS code, m.title AS name, CASE m.strength WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 WHEN '弱' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS v, coalesce(m.verdict, '待验证') AS grp FROM vi_moat_base m JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' ORDER BY length(m.code), m.code

SELECT v.code AS code, v.participant || CASE WHEN v.force IS NULL OR v.force = '不适用' THEN '' ELSE '（' || v.force || '）' END AS name, CASE v.power WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * CASE v.effect WHEN '有利' THEN 1 WHEN '不利' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS v, coalesce(v.effect, '中性') AS grp FROM vi_value_chain_base v JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = v.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' ORDER BY length(v.code), v.code

SELECT c.name AS "对手", x.k AS "指标", round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "%" FROM vi_competitor_base c JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = c.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('付费率或渗透率', c.paying_rate), ('毛利率', c.gross_margin), ('增速', c.growth)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.name || '（本公司）', x.k, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', h.gross_margin), ('增速', h.revenue_yoy)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL AND h.year = (SELECT max(h2.year) FROM vi_fin_history h2 WHERE h2.company_id = h.company_id) ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT coalesce(t.status, '未裁决') AS "裁决", count(*) AS n FROM vi_thesis_base t JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = t.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT d.period, d.line_item, round((d.yoy * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "同比（%）" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.yoy IS NOT NULL AND d.period_end >= vi_today() - interval '3 years' ORDER BY d.period_end, d.line_item

SELECT k.result, count(*) AS n FROM vi_check k JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = k.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' GROUP BY k.result ORDER BY k.result
SELECT f.verify_status, count(*) AS n FROM vi_fact_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' GROUP BY f.verify_status ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT o.obs_date, round((CASE WHEN co.price_fx_metric_id IS NULL THEN o.value ELSE o.value * fx.value END)::numeric, 2) AS "股价" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.price_metric_id = o.metric_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.value FROM vi_obs_current x WHERE x.metric_id = co.price_fx_metric_id AND x.obs_date <= o.obs_date ORDER BY x.obs_date DESC LIMIT 1) fx ON true ORDER BY o.obs_date
SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "数值" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code = 'CGB10Y.CCDC' ORDER BY o.obs_date
SELECT h.year, round(h.price::numeric, 3) AS "收入转化率" FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE h.price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year

SELECT left(d.period, 4) AS period, d.line_item AS "项目", round(d.value::numeric, 0) AS "亿元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE d.period_kind = '时点' AND d.period LIKE '%Q4' AND d.period >= '2019' AND d.line_item IN ('应收账款＋合同资产', '应付票据及应付账款') UNION ALL SELECT h.year::text, '营业收入', round(h.revenue::numeric, 0) FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE h.year >= 2019 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.period, round(d.value::numeric, 1) AS "减值" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE d.line_item = '资产及信用减值损失' AND d.period_kind = '全年' AND d.period >= '2019' ORDER BY d.period_end

历史：毛利率与 ROE（%）
历史：新签合同总额（建筑新签＋地产合约销售）（亿元）
